content:
**Hoppy Hunter IPA** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A hoppy, light-colored beer, Hoppy Hunter IPA, or "India pale ale," is brewed using brain fungus and Nuclear Material. It increases damage to animals and scope stability but reduces V.A.T.S. accuracy.

Similar to other fermentable beverages, Hoppy Hunter IPA is initially crafted as fermentable Hoppy Hunter IPA, offering no benefits and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented.

It shares its model with the regular unlabeled beer.

Hoppy Hunter IPA can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*. Crafting Hoppy Hunter IPA is unlocked during the quest Wasted on Alcohol.
